own_solution.law: Transmission-line step response: Z0 = sqrt(L/C) (totals, uniform line); V+ = E Z0/(Z0+Rs); V_load = V+ (1+Gamma_L), Gamma_L = (RL-Z0)/(RL+Z0)
assumptions: ideal step source with stated internal resistance

notes: Z0 = sqrt(0.025e-3 H / 10e-9 F) = 50 ohm. V+ = 10 x 50/75 = 6.667 V; Gamma_L = 100/200 = 0.5; V_load = 6.667 x 1.5 = 10.0 V. Length: L' = L/l and C' = C/l, so Z0 = sqrt(L'/C') = sqrt(L/C) and length cancels (it only sets the delay) -> C. Extra 42 ohm in series with source: Rs = 67 ohm, V+ = 500/117 = 4.274 V, V_load = 6.410 V. Lamp resistor and earlier-test resistor have no path to the line -> D. TBEAE and T0205 state 'a small resistor' with no number, unlike the numbered sentences.
